headline: Faleris fire flyer
title: Faleris | Fire Flying Mount With Kindling Six | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a flying mount that also cooks for your base in Palworld one point zero? Faleris is a Fire Pal with Kindling level six and Transporting level three. Its partner skill, Scorching Predator, lets you ride it through the sky, and Ice Pals in your party drop forty to eighty percent more items when defeated. Will you fly on Faleris? Comment below!
description: Faleris in Palworld 1.0 is a Fire flying mount with Kindling level six.
